mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(nickname, username, phone, email,sex, password, salt, avatar, intro,status, delete_flag,lock_flag,lock_time,website, github, create_time, update_time, login_ip,login_agent, login_time) VALUES (#{nickname},#{username},#{phone},#{email},#{sex},#{password},#{salt},#{avatar}, #{intro},#{status},#{deleteFlag},#{lockFlag},#{lockTime},#{website},#{github},#{createTime}, #{updateTime},#{loginIp},#{loginAgent},#{loginTime})
mapper.select: select r.* from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id inner join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id where u.id = #{userId}
